learning_outcomes.text: The Bachelor thesis provides students with the basic knowledge of scientific work in a subfield of mechanical engineering under guidance.

Successful completion of the Bachelor thesis ensures that students have acquired the necessary technical knowledge for a first career entry and can solve problems in the field using scientific methods.
Students analyze a problem of medium difficulty within a given period, identify suitable models and methods, and use them to solve the task.

Students first abstract the problem appropriately so that the problem statement can be classified. In the analysis, students use literature and classify the problem statement and their work with its help.

In the written elaboration, students acquire basic knowledge in scientific writing and demonstrate their ability to prepare and present technical topics understandably in an appropriate form during a scientific seminar.

syllabus_topics: Issue of a research question with suitable literature
Preparation and timely submission of the written elaboration

assessment_methods.method: Presentation of approx. 30 minutes (including discussion) within a seminar

assessment_rules: The overall module grade is 100% based on the Bachelor thesis, which includes the written elaboration and a presentation with discussion.
